newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED ON WEDNESDAY.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED ON WEDNESDAY.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer on the U.S. dollar and the mark but took a knock against sterling and the rand on Wednesday, dealers said.

"We saw the Zimbabwe dollar gaining but I don't think there was any form of (central) Reserve Bank intervention -- banks were just profit taking (by selling their excess U.S. dollars)", a dealer said.

Dealers said most players were wary of being caught long when the annual tobbacco auctions kicked off in April and were off-loading to avoid taking losses when the local dollar started appreciating, as it was widely expected to do.
Tobacco is one of the southern African country's major foreign exchange earners.
At Wednesday's close, the Zimbabwe dollar was quoted at 11.2650/2750 against the U.S. dollar from 11.2675/2775 on Tuesday and was at 6.6580/6660 from 6.6700/6900 versus the mark.
Against pound sterling however it slipped to 18.2850/3130 from 18.2100/2300 and was at 2.5440/5480 against the rand, down from 2.5400/5600.
